### Issue 2: Revocation URL Format Inconsistency

**Severity**: MODERATE
**File**: `gws-readonly-safety.md`, line 106 vs `references/token-lifecycle.md`, lines 51-55
**Status: RESOLVED**

**Actual (summary)**:
```
POST to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke?token={token}
```
Token is passed as a **query parameter**.

**Actual (reference)**:
```
POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
token={access_or_refresh_token}
```
Token is passed in the **request body**.

**Expected**: Both files should use the same format. Citation [11] describes POST to the revocation endpoint. The reference file's body-parameter format is the standard OAuth 2.0 revocation pattern (RFC 7009). The summary's query-parameter format is a different (and less correct) representation.
**Grade**: FAIL
